PRINT TYPE CATEGORIES

The same card image can be printed on different materials that cannot always be distinguished during identification, so cards should be separated by material type before sorting. A Roca Sifter can assist by separating foil from non-foil cards, but specific foil styles such as Cold Foil vs. Rainbow Foil must be separated manually.
